meta.rule: Hours and prices only where an official page prints them. Blank means not verified. 'per couple' means cost for 2 adults.
meta.activity_social_rule: Only links seen on or found for the named venue. Instagram/TikTok handles left blank rather than guessed. YouTube links are real video URLs found via search 2026-11-27; blank TikTok means no official account verified.

activities.name: Sphere Las Vegas (The Wizard of Oz / concerts)
activities.exceptions: The 2027 show calendar at this venue is not yet fully published. Prices shown are the vendor's current listing, not a February 2027 rate.
activities.price_note: Sphere does not print a single admission price — it depends on the show. Booking.com's own listing shows 'Admission to The Wizard of Oz at The Sphere' from $131.45 per person; that is a reseller price, not the venue's box office price.
activities.notes: The single most distinctive thing to do in Las Vegas right now. Book only once the 2027 calendar is live. Social: IG @SphereVegas per Sphere Entertainment PRNewswire release 2025-02-27; TikTok @spherevegas official account. YouTube: three Wizard of Oz at Sphere videos found via search 2026-11-27.

activities.name: High Roller Observation Wheel
activities.exceptions: Schedule conflict on official page (27 Nov 2026): opens 12:30 PM; ticket cards say daytime 12–5 PM and anytime 12 PM–close; FAQ says daytime 12–5:59 PM and anytime starts 6 PM. Complete opening/closing hours left unverified. 30-minute rotation; allow an hour for boarding and exit.
activities.price_note: Official FAQ: adult daytime $23.50, adult anytime $34.75, Happy Half Hour (21+) $60. Each is 'plus taxes and fees'. Two adults at the two standard tiers = $47.00 and $69.50 before tax.
activities.notes: Happy Half Hour is an open-bar cabin with a bartender for the full rotation. IG @highrollervegas confirmed via multiple sources 2026-11-27. TikTok: no official account verified (only creator videos tagging @highrollervegas) — left blank, see F-53. Hours/prices re-verified 2026-11-27 on Caesars official page (Opens 12:30PM; daytime $23.50, anytime $34.75, Happy Half Hour $60, plus taxes/fees).

activities.name: The Mob Museum
activities.hours: Museum: daily 9:00 AM–9:00 PM. Underground: Sun–Thu 11:00 AM–11:00 PM; Fri–Sat 11:00 AM–midnight.
activities.exceptions: Official weekly table rechecked 27 Nov 2026. Early closures override normal hours; consult official hours/directions calendar. Former every-Thursday 4 PM closure was a holiday exception, not the weekly schedule. 2027 exceptions not confirmed.
activities.price_note: Official ticketing: General Admission $37.95 per adult (includes The Underground). Two adults = $75.90. Deluxe Pass $49.95 pp, Premier Pass $54.95 pp (both include one or two interactive experiences).
activities.notes: A morning-arrival discount and an evening-arrival discount are offered online only on the Premier Pass. Social: IG/TikTok @themobmuseum per the museum's own press release (reprinted Nevada Business 2026-11-02). Hours re-verified 2026-11-27 on themobmuseum.org homepage table.

activities.name: The Neon Museum
activities.hours: Sep–May 3:00 PM – 11:00 PM (last entry 10:00 PM). Jun–Aug 8:00 PM – midnight.
activities.exceptions: From 1 Jan 2027 the separate daytime/evening tickets are replaced by a single '2027 Admission' valid across operating hours.
activities.price_note: Official site: 2027 Admission 'from $21' per person, daily 3–11 PM. Two adults from $42. The 2026 daytime tier was from $25 and the 2026 evening tier from $35 — both expire 31 Dec 2026, which is before the trip.
activities.notes: Social handles taken directly from the museum's own site footer (re-verified 2026-11-27: TikTok @neonmuseumlasvegas, Instagram @theneonmuseumlasvegas). 45-minute guided History and Movies tours are add-ons. Hours/prices re-verified 2026-11-27 (Sep–May 3–11 PM; 2027 Admission from $21).

activities.name: Fremont Street Experience
activities.hours: Canopy light shows and live music nightly; schedule published on the venue calendar
activities.price_note: Free entry. The venue states live concerts and performances run on three stages every night.
activities.notes: Free — the obvious way to keep a downtown evening cheap. SlotZilla zipline is a paid add-on on the same site. IG @fremontstreet is the official Fremont Street Experience account (verified 2026-11-27). TikTok: no official account verified — left blank, see F-53.

not_verified.name: Bellagio Fountains
not_verified.reason: The official Bellagio page for the fountains returned a fetch error twice. Show times and the current schedule could not be confirmed, so no hours or links are published here. Free to watch; check https://www.bellagio.com/ on arrival.
